claim: AWS recommends Kinesis Data Streams for use cases that need to consume records in the same order a few hours later. Because Kinesis Data Streams stores data for up to 365 days, an audit application can run up to 365 days behind a billing application.

evidence.quote: We recommend Kinesis Data Streams for use cases with requirements that are similar to the following:

Ability to consume records in the same order a few hours later. For example, you have a billing application and an audit application that runs a few hours behind the billing application. Because Kinesis Data Streams stores data for up to 365 days, you can run the audit application up to 365 days behind the billing application.
